certificate.note: ⛔ An unbounded-below landscape does not settle, it diverges — measured at E = -1.6e28 on the first smoke. The certificate is computed from the ATOMS, never hand-tuned.

no_bypass.note: The output path has no argument through which encoder information could travel except the K integer codes.

path: request → launch read → codes → THE frozen decoder → image → THE external classifier

checked.statistic: in-corner shape balanced accuracy on REAL held-out images

store.note: ⭐ the CLU arm's probe-space number must reproduce gen-read-compose's row bit-identically

request_only_path.note: ⛔ Neither arm takes a feature tensor. The CLU-wide mixture weights are the softmax of address_requests' per-well log-scores on the REQUEST; gen_store.soft_read (same arithmetic, features as input) is not imported.

rival_regression_check.rule: probe-companion vs the arm's own published probe number, same statistic, same seed; ⛔ never external-vs-probe

row_split.rule: deficit-priority greedy on the pool's own per-factor marginals (target[f][v] = n_val * count_pool[f][v] / n_pool), seeded tie-break
